environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in namespace 'payments' on the same Istio 1.19 mesh. The mesh-wide PeerAuthentication enforces STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-cross-ns-debug' is applied in the 'payments' namespace with spec.rules matching requests to paths '/api/v1/debug/*' — the policy uses a 'DENY' action with a 'when' condition: source.namespace is 'not payments' (using notValues). Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-intra-ns' with ALLOW action permits only source.principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/*'. Since Istio evaluates DENY policies first, any cross-namespace request to debug endpoints is rejected at the Envoy proxy level before reaching the Flask container. Intra-namespace access is restricted to the 'payments-controller' ServiceAccount via a third ALLOW policy scoped to the debug paths.
